How Gameweek 2 Actually Went

Manchester United answered a chastening opening week by putting five past Ipswich, Manchester City took Crystal Palace apart 4–1, and Chelsea and Brighton produced the game of the round at 4–3.

Liverpool 2–2 Nottingham Forest

  • Hull City beat Coventry City 1–0
  • Ipswich Town lost to Manchester United 2–5
The promoted clubs, week by week. Their record is recounted every edition rather than carried over — cheap defenders from newly promoted sides are the difference between a good week and a bad one, and this league keeps not owning them.

Better or Worse Than Usual?

A gameweek score on its own tells you very little — 45 points is a disaster for one manager and a fine week for another. So here is everyone measured against themselves: this week's score against their own long-run average from previous seasons.

Bittencourt FC scored 63.2 points above their own long-run average, the biggest overshoot in the league. TEAM OFFEI is the closest to par at +7.5 — which means every single manager with a track record beat their own average this week. Every past champion beat their own average this week — Guigo (+63.2), Súper (+53.2), Fragata (+49.4). Ominous.

What Changed in the Rules

the six changes for 2026/27 — tap to open
  1. 1. Live points, live tables. Points now update while matches are being played — appearances, goals, assists, clean sheets and defensive contribution. Mini-league standings move in real time too, so the Expendables table will be live all afternoon. New
  2. 2. Projected bonus after 20 minutes. Provisional bonus appears once a match passes the 20-minute mark, and shifts as the game goes on. It is a projection, not a result — it can and will change. New
  3. 3. Bonus Points System reworked. Rebuilt to cut the overlap where one player earned both BPS and defensive contribution points for the same actions. Goalkeepers, full-backs and attackers are all expected to see more bonus. Changed
  4. 4. Price prediction tool. FPL now shows you who is likely to rise or fall, tracking transfer activity against the daily price change at midnight UK time. New
  5. 5. Scores finalise later. Gameweek lockdown moves to 09:00 UK time the morning after the last match, rather than an hour after the final whistle — extra time for Opta to review the stats. Changed
  6. 6. Chips are unchanged. Two full sets again — Wildcard, Free Hit, Triple Captain and Bench Boost, one of each per half of the season. Same
What this means for our money. Later lockdown at 09:00 UK is 4:00am ET — so Sunday-night scores are not final until Monday morning. The Times goes out Tuesday for exactly this reason, and no block or weekly-high prize is settled on provisional bonus.

The small print — terms, rights and the legal bit

A private game. Invitation-only contest between friends, run for entertainment. No fee, commission or rake — every dollar goes back out as prizes.

Independent. No connection to or endorsement by the Premier League, Fantasy Premier League, any club or ESPN. Names and marks belong to their owners and are used descriptively.

Skill, and your own local law. Decided by each manager's selections over a season. Rules on paid fantasy contests vary by state and country — each player is responsible for their own. Don't enter if it isn't lawful where you live.

Money. Buy-ins are personal contributions to a members' pot, not payment for goods or services, arranged privately. Paid out in full at season's end. Winners handle their own taxes.

Accuracy. Figures come from public APIs and are checked automatically, but can still be wrong. Fantasy Premier League's official scores settle every result and prize, never anything printed here. No warranty; not betting, financial or legal advice.

Names and images. Managers appear as they chose when joining — ask to be initials only, or removed. Photographs are freely licensed and credited; rights holders can ask for removal.

Disputes. The commissioner settles interpretation in good faith and won't change rules mid-season to alter a finished result. Disagree with a ruling and you can withdraw before the next gameweek for a full refund.

Written by the commissioner, not a lawyer. Not legal advice.
